evidence: Official docs for the aiToon NPR shader: cel shading via ramp tonemaps, edge lines via Contour Filter, stylized highlight and rim lighting; documented limits include no motion blur/DOF and direct-lighting-only on GPU.

Official UTS docs: production-grade cel shading across Built-in, URP and HDRP with three-color base/1st/2nd shadow design plus outline, rim light, MatCap and 'Angel Ring' highlight controls used in anime pipelines.
Official UTS3 repository confirms cel-shaded animation use case, inspector-level color-region control independent of scene lighting, and links to maintained documentation and samples.

Arc System Works' GDC 2015 talk on rebuilding 2D anime aesthetics in UE3: custom cel shaders, hand-edited normals for shading control, dedicated outline-extrusion normals, and deliberately limited animation timing.
Speaker-released slide deck documenting the studio postmortem: why cel-shaded 3D was chosen over sprites and the specific shader/mesh authoring rules that made the anime look hold up at HD.
Postmortem on Spider-Verse stylization: misregistration for defocus, halftone tone rendering, hand-drawn FX passes and panelized stepped frame rates built over a 3D CG pipeline.
Studio account of Spider-Verse: animating on twos, rigging facial line work as animatable elements, and stylized rendering requiring pipeline rework in every department.
Production notes: ~95% CG film where pencil lines were modeled in CG, asymmetric models and clay-like textures were used to fight the clean 3D look without post filters.

Pixar's 'Stylizing Animation By Example' paper: temporally coherent painterly stylization over lit 3D animation with artist-painted keyframes as constraints; foundational technique for hand-painted CG looks.
Technical breakdown of cel shading in UE5: critiques the common toon-render approach, then presents a PBR-consistent cel-shading method with outline repurposing and downloadable project files.
Official docs for C4D's built-in NPR engine: post-effect line rendering, Cel/Art/Hatch/Spots shaders for halftone and comic looks; noted limitation, incompatible with Physical Renderer and Redshift.
HIK is a full-body IK solver/retargeter in Maya: full-body and body-part keying, auxiliary effectors/pinning, and retargeting between skeletons of different proportions and hierarchies.
CAT is 3ds Max's character-animation plug-in covering rigging, nonlinear animation, animation layering, mocap import and muscle simulation via modular CATRig skeletons.
CATRig supports script-free rig building: hub-based modular skeletons, per-limb IK, layered animation, procedural walk-cycle system, pose/clip system and rig-to-rig animation transfer.

C4D's current retargeting stack: Character Definition tag maps hierarchies by naming conventions, Character Solver tag transfers motion across differently proportioned/oriented skeletons; supersedes the old Retarget tag.
Component-template rigging built by Disney Animation TD Bret Bays: biped/quadruped/bird/fish presets, mirrored components, auto-binding with adjustable weighting and animator-facing HUD controls.

Mecanim overview: Animator Controller state machines, blend trees, animation layers/avatar masks, humanoid retargeting via muscle space and root motion handling; clips authored externally in Maya/Max.
Official package for runtime/procedural constraint rigs (IK, multi-aim, etc.) built on Animation C# Jobs, incl. Bidirectional Motion Transfer between a rig and a skeleton.

tool: Unreal Engine IK Rig / IK Retargeter
evidence: UE5's retargeting system: source/target IK Rigs with joint chains plus IK Retargeter assets and retarget poses transfer animation between dissimilar skeletons and proportions, incl. human-to-quadruped.
Official learning hub: Control Rig enables Maya-style keyframed animation with IK inside UE; Backwards Solve and Bake to Control Rig convert skeletal animation to editable rig curves.
Physics-based keyframe tool: AutoPhysics generates physically accurate results from keyframes, AutoPosing reduces control points, plus rig generation, mocap cleanup and FBX/USD/glTF pipeline support.

Interview with Cascadeur's CTO: AutoPhysics auto-computes the physically correct animation closest to the animator's input; toolset grew from Nekki's Shadow Fight production needs (center of mass, angular momentum).

Character retargeting properties: Match Source stride/proportion adaptation, Action Space Compensation, per-bone Reach percentages, mirroring and offsets; the mocap industry standard retarget toolset.

Mixamo is a free, browser/cloud service (Adobe ID, no CC subscription); auto-rigger and motion library are bipedal-humanoid only and reject non-neutral poses, extra appendages or floating parts; fully server-side processing.
Maya 2025 animation updates: reworked Motion Trails system, rebuilt Dope Sheet for timing edits, Graph Editor curve-sculpting changes, plus Smart Extrude and LookdevX MaterialX support.
Pro-press rundown of UE5.5 animation: Control Rig-embedded deformers, AnimatorKit plugin, Sequencer workflow upgrades, and experimental audio-driven facial animation in the MetaHuman plugin.
Core sculpting feature set: 30+ base brushes with custom brush authoring, SubTools multiplying workable polycounts per system limit, 3D Layers for non-linear detail control and HD Geometry.
Sculptris Pro adds dynamic tessellation: polygons are added/removed under the brush, removing topology constraints during sculpting; works alongside DynaMesh, scans and Live Boolean outputs.
ZRemesher v3 automatic retopology: improved hard-surface edge detection, crease- and PolyGroup-driven edge flow, guide curves for loop control, and projection of detail to displacement/normal maps.
FiberMesh generates real groomable hair/fur geometry as SubTools, editable with dedicated Groom brushes and exportable as fibers or guide curves (OBJ/modo/Maya/LightWave, FMG).
Official docs for cloud-based, guided digital-human creation producing fully rigged, UE-ready characters with consistent topology and facial rigs; no manual skinning required.

Coverage of MetaHuman's reveal: browser app over Unreal Pixel Streaming claims digital-human build time from weeks to under an hour, with common pro-grade rig drivable via LiveLink and third-party mocap tools.
GDC 2023 announcement: MetaHuman Animator turns iPhone or stereo HMC footage into high-fidelity facial animation on any MetaHuman, with timecode support to sync body mocap (e.g., Xsens) and audio.
Deep dive on Mesh to MetaHuman: automated landmark tracking fits the MetaHuman template to user scans, then cloud processing returns a fully rigged, animatable character.
CC4 official manual: full character generation/rig pipeline with AccuRIG auto-rigging, Smart Hair, SkinGen, digital human shader, subdivision/LOD export targeting iClone, Maya, Unreal and Unity.
iClone 8 facial system documentation: revamped expression control driving Face Puppet, Face Key and Face Mocap, with voice-script lipsync; all backward compatible with earlier expression assets.
Community-standard reference defining retopo for animation-ready meshes: clean edge flow, then detail transfer via displacement/normal baking, with links to app-specific retopo workflows.
Professional review: full ZBrush brush set rewritten for iPad (not a port), sculpting up to ~90M polygons on M-chip iPads, easier UI than desktop; notes a few pro tools still missing.
